environment.description: Ktor microservice deployed on EKS behind an AWS NLB (Network Load Balancer) with TLS termination. Service mesh (Istio) handles mTLS between services. Authentication is performed by an upstream OAuth2 proxy that sets X-Authenticated-User and X-User-Role headers. No request body validation or schema enforcement at the network edge. The NLB passes through all HTTP traffic directly to the pod. Istio authorization policies only check source principal identity, not request body content.

config.service_mesh: Istio 1.19 with STRICT mTLS peer authentication
